purpose: parārthaṃ svārthaṃ ca (for others and for himself)
notes: The word 'vāde' just before 'śivarāmeṇa' is unclear. It may be the scribe's family name (compare the Marathi surname Vāḍe/Wade), a place name in the locative ('at Vāḍa/Vāde'), or a corruption. It is not taken as the place of copying here. The era is not named ('saṃvat'), but VS fits the Devanagari script and the catalogue: VS 1809 = 1752 CE (Vaiśākha falls in April–May). The 'owner' role is not given because the copy was made for others as well as for the scribe (parārthaṃ svārthaṃ ca).
